mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and 69 degrees at the Verona Area High School. We also have a Full Moon tonight, and while the ISS will pass overhead, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Regarding city news, please be aware that Hwy M will be closed near the future Aldi site from October 5 to October 7 to allow for final asphalt and paving work. Please follow the posted detours using Old PB, E Verona Ave, and S Main St.
There is plenty to do, with Live Music at Bailey's Run happening today, followed by Yoga at Insight Wellness tomorrow.

On September 5, the Verona Police Department investigated a unique incident where multiple vehicles around East Harriet Street and surrounding areas had slices of cheese placed on their windshields as part of a social media prank.
Today's flavor of the day is Turtle. Since the restaurant is currently open until 10:00 PM, we encourage you to stop by and grab a treat.
